metric.model_rows: test-block forecast rows (horizons 1-21, every 3rd day) that used the model, i.e. uses_baseline = false
metric.ratio: MAE of price_mid / MAE of 'same as today', on model rows only, pooled over horizons; below 1 = model beats 'price stays the same'
metric.coverage: share of all test-block real prices inside [price_low, price_high], pooled over horizons (model and fallback rows)

note: Version 2's rules (monthly refit, trailing self-check, trailing widening) were chosen after seeing version 1's test-block result, so version 2's test numbers are not an untouched holdout.
